decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The basement unit hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling known as 24 Beverley Road, Chiswick, W4 2LP.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and none shall take place on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Construction of a basement for use as playroom/store, demolition of existing store area on side and erection of a side and rear extension and other alterations to existing dwellinghouse.
